name: Berserk
additional_info: While in the Berserk State, your M1s will gain increased PEN, scaling on how low your health is. This will cap at 50% if you do not have Million Ton Piercer. Additionally, your critical attacks gain +10% PEN. In exchange for this, all damage you take is true damage for the duration of the effect. In PvE, your M1s always gain +100% PEN, regardless of your health value. Lasts 20 seconds, halved to 10 seconds if you do not meet the Talent's Strength requirement. Berserk can be deactivated after 10 seconds by using the Talent tool again.
desc: One with nothing to lose has everything to gain. Succumb to burning rage within and enter Berserk State.
